title: FBI-UAP-PR002, “Red Orb Rotation,” Northeastern United States, 2022
what_is_it: A public release record for an FBI eyewitness UAP video (an iPhone-captured clip of two red lights), described only by war.gov catalogue metadata — the PDF itself yielded no readable text.
interpretation_warnings: Single-source account: all details derive from one eyewitness's statements to the FBI, not independent measurement.
Key figures (2,500 feet distance, clock-position motion) are the witness's estimates, not instrument readings.
The 'highly credible' assessment is the FBI's judgement of the person, not verification of what was seen.
No PDF body text was extractable (scanned/OCR-poor); this analysis rests on catalogue metadata and the war.gov CSV description only.
The CSV description is truncated mid-sentence, so cross-references to related files (FBI-UAP-D004–D008, FBI-UAP-PR001) are incomplete.
